notes: AGRICARBON UOL001-A01 Results v3.3 PUBLISH 2024-03-14 CSV.xlsx; sheet CSV - Samples. Original file remains unchanged.
188 depth records from 96 cores: 24 tree-row, 24 alley, 48 arable-reference cores. Missing lower layers are not filled.
265 company rows from study Fields 1 and 2, including deeper samples. No depth boundaries are invented for suffixes .3 and later.
Company field IDs and coordinates; matched profile audit; original design screenshot; colleague row/block account; user orientation confirmation on 22 October 2026.
Rows run approximately north to south. West to east: row 6 / Block 1 / F, row 10 / Block 2 / C, row 14 / Block 3 / A.
User confirms Field 1 was arable. Open grassland on field-plan page 4 is an Agricarbon labelling error.
Legacy 1_tree_25 matches arable core UOL001-A01-001.0-A-016. Both layers now belong to 3_arable; original identifiers remain in legacy columns.
BD and SOC values come directly from company results without two-decimal rounding. They may differ slightly from prior analysis inputs.
Former treatment is the historical cropping regime associated with a row and adjacent alleys. A does not identify a permanently cropped/fallow side.
Each former treatment occurs in one sampled block/row band. Cores are spatial subsamples, not independent treatment blocks.
Hybrid and annual crop-side assignments are not inferred. Post-trial management history remains to be documented.
Use soil_0_30 as replacement input; fine_bd_gcm3 and SOC_perc retain familiar measurement names. Stable IDs are company IDs; treatment is explicitly former_treatment_code.
Existing SOC outputs and analysis scripts have not been rerun or switched to this input as part of dataset creation.
poplar_paper/data/processed/study_site_soil_2024.csv contains identical main-sheet values, with ISO text dates.
